supporting_observations.claim: At 13:42:16 UTC, dan.reyes opened C:\Users\dan.reyes\Downloads\Statement.docm in Microsoft Word from Explorer.

Two seconds later, Word spawned PowerShell with no profile, a hidden window, and an encoded command. The command decodes to an invocation of WebClient.DownloadString for https://raw.githubusercontent.com/copperline-it/tools/main/u.ps1.

PowerShell made a proxied HTTP connection with 12,222 response bytes, then another proxied connection with 1,565 response bytes; the timing and process telemetry are consistent with the encoded download command.
PowerShell created a temporary file and then spawned rundll32 with the command line C:\Users\dan.reyes\AppData\Roaming\svchelper.dll,Init.
PowerShell, Word, and rundll32 exited within about 20 seconds of the initial PowerShell launch.

known_telemetry_limitations: Proxy logs for the proxy host were not collected from 13:25 to 14:20 UTC, including the alerted activity window; the available connection records identify the proxy endpoint and byte counts but do not provide the proxy request URL or content.
The available records do not include the contents of Statement.docm, the downloaded script, the temporary file, or svchelper.dll.
